# Echoes of the Garden

> A free-to-play idle game and creature collector with permadeath, in development for PC. Creatures are born, grow old and die for good, and each death leaves a choice: an Inherited Seed or a Relic. By Digital Multiverse, a solo developer.

- Status: in development, playable on itch.io, coming to Steam Early Access
- Languages: English, Spanish, Italian

- [Home](https://echoesofthegarden.com/): the game, its systems and the roadmap
- [Dev log](https://echoesofthegarden.com/devlog/): one entry per milestone
